whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Darb?
whyChooseUs.subtitle: We walk with you every step of the way. Here's how we support you toward an exceptional experience.

reasons.title: Personal Support & Ongoing Follow-up
reasons.description: You get a dedicated advisor who accompanies you every step, from choosing your major to settling in your study destination.

reasons.title: Fast & Reliable Processes
reasons.description: Thanks to our direct relationships with universities, we prepare and follow up on your application quickly and efficiently. Admission and visa decisions rest with the official authorities.

reasons.title: Highly Experienced Specialists
reasons.description: Our team consists of experts who have lived the study abroad experience and are ready to share their knowledge with you.

reasons.title: Global Network of Accredited Partners
reasons.description: We open doors to the best universities and educational institutions worldwide through our extensive partner network.

reasons.title: Complete Transparency at Every Step
reasons.description: We believe in full clarity. No hidden fees, and we keep you informed of all details about your application.

reasons.title: End-to-End Support from Application to Arrival
reasons.description: Our services don't end at university admission — they extend to visa assistance, housing, and reception.

scope.title: We know our role—and explain every institution’s role
scope.body: Darb professionally guides you and prepares your file, but does not replace the university or embassy and never promises a decision it cannot control.
scope.imageAlt: Students inside a university building in Germany
scope.imageCaption: Professional guidance; official decisions remain with the responsible authorities
decisions: The university or school decides admission
The embassy and authorities decide the visa
The insurer is responsible for the coverage contract
The housing provider is responsible for the lease and deposit

pricing.title: Clear pricing after we understand what you need
pricing.body: We do not show a generic price that may not reflect your case. We first define the required service, then provide a written breakdown before any commitment.
pricing.assessBody: We identify the services your profile needs without adding what it does not.
pricing.breakdownBody: You receive a clear explanation of fees, inclusions, and third-party costs.
pricing.paymentBody: No payment is processed online; agreements and payment take place at the Darb office.

parents.title: Trust begins with knowing what is happening in the file
parents.body: Studying abroad is a major family decision. We give students and families understandable follow-up, not vague promises.

faq.title: Important questions deserve clear answers
faq.body: Short answers to help you choose your next step with confidence.

items.title: Does Darb guarantee admission or a visa?
items.description: No. Darb professionally prepares and follows the file, while admissions and visa decisions remain solely with universities and the responsible authorities.

items.title: How much does the service cost?
items.description: It depends on your profile and the services required. After assessment, you receive a clear written breakdown before any commitment.

items.title: Do I pay through the website?
items.description: No. The website processes no payments. Agreements, signatures, and payment take place in person at the Darb office.

items.title: What is the first step?
items.description: Request a profile assessment or contact us on WhatsApp. We will explain what information is needed and the most suitable next step.

final.title: You do not need to know the whole route today
final.body: Send your details so we can understand your profile, or speak with us directly on WhatsApp. We will help you identify the right first step.
